scope: Product code, APIs, UI, bundled tools and product security decisions. Deployment responsibilities and non-applicable requirements omitted.
method: Static review, counter-review and limited isolated unit tests; no full dynamic acceptance or penetration test.

standards.name: OWASP ASVS
standards.countMeaning: Source rows screened, not requirements proven compliant.

cryptoObservation.note: Synthetic generated secret and code are not output. This calls the product verifier only; login replay prevention is a separate control.

assertions.name: offline restore archive validation requires an isolated database and object-storage bucket

offline restore archive validation refuses missing or mismatched artifact checksums
offline restore archive validation accepts the shape the backup path produces

offline restore archive validation validates manifest object keys directly
offline restore archive validation applies tombstones and verifies the final object collection
offline restore archive validation requires the archive file set to exactly match its manifest
offline restore archive validation rejects unsafe remote base paths
backup credential JSON validation accepts the existing protocol credential formats
backup credential JSON validation rejects non-object JSON credential values
backup credential JSON validation rejects unknown fields and non-string fields per protocol
backup credential JSON validation surfaces invalid credentials as a 422 API validation error
backup credential JSON validation rejects control characters in every credential field
backup credential JSON validation rejects ambiguous config values before saving them
backup credential JSON validation accepts empty optional credentials and keeps the setup compatibility entry point
backup credential JSON validation keeps artifact encryption independent from rotated remote credentials
backup credential JSON validation re-resolves every remote endpoint before invoking rclone
